title: Koko Eating Bananas
oneLinerQuestion: Find the minimum integer eating speed k to eat all bananas within h hours.
explanation: Binary search speed k within range [1, max(piles)]. Calculate total hours needed for speed k; adjust range to find minimum valid speed.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION minEatingSpeed(piles, h):
    l = 1, r = MAX(piles), res = r
    WHILE l <= r DO:
        k = (l + r) / 2
        hours = SUM(CEIL(p / k) FOR p IN piles)
        IF hours <= h THEN res = k; r = k - 1
        ELSE l = k + 1
    END WHILE
    RETURN res
END FUNCTION

steps.narration: Line 2: Piles: [3, 6, 7, 11], h = 8. Search range for eating speed k: l = 1, r = 11, res = 11.
Line 4: Mid speed k = (1 + 11) / 2 = 6. Calculate hours: ceil(3/6)+ceil(6/6)+ceil(7/6)+ceil(11/6) = 1+1+2+2 = 6 hrs. 6 <= 8 (Valid!). res = 6, r = 5.
Line 4: Next mid speed k = (1 + 5) / 2 = 3. Hours: ceil(3/3)+ceil(6/3)+ceil(7/3)+ceil(11/3) = 1+2+3+4 = 10 hrs. 10 > 8 (Too slow!). l = 3 + 1 = 4.
Line 4: Next mid speed k = (4 + 5) / 2 = 4. Hours: 1+2+2+3 = 8 hrs. 8 <= 8 (Valid!). res = 4, r = 3.
Line 8: l > r (4 > 3). Binary search terminates. RETURN res = 4.
